The plate looks like a side or dinner plate. Its outer diameter spans about 655 px, so at roughly 22-24 cm that works out to about 0.035 cm per px.

Each rib rack piece is about 440 px long, or roughly 15 cm, and about 100 px wide, or roughly 3.5 cm. These are pieces of pork spare rib, each a short strip of rib bones with meat, probably 3-4 bones.

I'd estimate each piece at about 90-100 g including the bones. That gives about 190 g for the two pieces together.

Pork ribs with sauce come to roughly 250 kcal per 100 g of cooked weight including bone. The edible portion is lower because of the bone, so I'll use about 200 kcal per 100 g across the whole weight. That gives about 380 kcal for the plate.
